text: If you are not flying, you should be responsible for everything except the physical manipulation of the controls. This responsibility includes all navigation and communication frequency changes, all radio communication, and, of course, gear, flaps, lights, and the appropriate checklists. Stay ahead of the situation. Anticipate the needs of your fellow crew members and be prepared to help. Question. Which of the following is not mentioned as the responsibilities for the PNF?
